page.overview:
What is Don't Let Me Down?

Don't Let Me Down is a love song by The Beatles. It is one of four Beatles songs credited to the Beatles with Billy Preston. It first appeared on the B-side of the Get Back single on April 11, 1969. it has been covered numerous times, and appeared in the 2007 film Across the Universe.

Click [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NCtzkaL2t_Y here] for see the last concert of all The Fab Four Category:Songs credited to The Beatles with Billy Preston Category:B-sides Category:The Beatles songs Category:Non-album singles Category:Songs written by John Lennon
